 This identification is corroborated by DharmaNexus, which records a near-verbatim match between the two compositions spanning segments §0.3–19.3 with an alignment similarity of 0.94 [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also reveals substantial reuse in the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā* (Paṭhamo bhāgo), where verses corresponding to §1.1–16.3 are cited or incorporated into the commentary (§3740–3771), with further overlaps occurring in the *Therīgāthā-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus]. In addition, stock verses from its concluding sections (§§15–20) are shared with numerous other poems in the collection, including the *Sabbaphaladāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 521), the *Ekāsanadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 425), and the *Nadīkassapattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 554) [DharmaNexus].
